# bookmatch — internal mechanisms of the index build, deploy, and schema surface

> [!warning]
> **Documentation:** `docs/` carries the generated six-doc set (scope, architecture, workflows, data, quality, internals) — read it before reading code. Do not edit; it regenerates nightly.

## Migrations

N/A: repo owns no database objects beyond the `books` schema created by `bookmatch.storage`; no migration files are present in the fact sheet.

## DDL surface

The `books` schema is created by `bookmatch.storage` (confirmed at `./bookmatch/storage.py:101`). The `books` table is defined as:

```sql
CREATE TABLE books (
    book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT,
    author TEXT
)
```

The `lookup` table is defined as:

```sql
CREATE TABLE lookup (
    normkey TEXT,
    book_id INTEGER
)
```

An index is created on the `lookup` table's `normkey` column for fast lookups. The `books` table uses `INSERT OR IGNORE` for batch inserts.

## Triggers & guarantees

- **No duplicate books** — `INSERT OR IGNORE` on the `books` table makes duplicate `book_id` inserts impossible.
- **Fast lookup** — the index on `lookup.normkey` guarantees O(log n) lookups by normalized key. UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
- **Schema readiness** — `storage.ensure_schema_ready` (confirmed at `./bookmatch/app.py:37`) verifies the `books.*` schema exists and raises if missing; it never creates the schema as a side effect.

## Decision semantics

### Deploy gate

`deploy.sh` makes three sequential decisions before restarting the service:

| input | verdict |
|---|---|
| current branch is not `main` | refuse to deploy |
| working tree is dirty | refuse to deploy |
| `HEAD` does not match `origin/main` | refuse to deploy |

### Health check

`healthy()` in `deploy.sh` polls `/api/health` for both `ok` and `corpus_ready` flags, up to 20 seconds.

### Rollback decision

On failed deploy, the script rolls back to the last known-good revision recorded in `.deploy-last-good`. If no last-good revision is recorded, rollback is impossible and an error is logged.

## Constants that matter

| name | value | consequence |
|---|---|---|
| `BOOKMATCH_RAW` | `~/data/goodreads-ucsd/raw` | raw data directory; overridable via env |
| `BOOKMATCH_INDEX` | `~/data/goodreads-ucsd/index` | output index directory; overridable via env |
| chunk size | 20,000,000 rows | `build_matrix` reads `goodreads_interactions.csv` in chunks of this size |
| batch size | 50,000 | `build_lookup` inserts books in batches of this size |
| curl retries | 5 | download script retries each file up to 5 times |
| curl timeout | 2 hours | per-file download timeout |
| health poll timeout | 20 seconds | `healthy()` polls `/api/health` up to this long |
